Frequently asked questions

How much does a trip from the catalog cost?

The price is available upon request. Each trip is quoted based on its dates, departure city, and number of people, and we send the quote with payment options via WhatsApp.

What is OND's official WhatsApp?

OND's WhatsApp number is (11) 91021-4133. You can also speak directly with the partners: Renan Rodrigues, at (11) 94361-5412, and Renan Chaves, at (11) 95335-3347.

How do I buy a trip from the catalog?

Tap "I want this trip" for your desired destination. Enter your name, departure and return dates, and who will be going, and OND's WhatsApp will open with everything already filled in. OND will then send you a proposal including flights, accommodation, and tours.

Is OND a travel agency?

Yes. OND is a travel agency registered with Cadastur, the official registry of the Ministry of Tourism, with CNPJ 39.360.492/0001-61. You plan with OND vAI and purchase the trip with OND or with a partner agency.

What can you buy with OND?

Airfare, accommodation, and tours. You can also include travel insurance and transfers, all in the same plan.

How much does it cost to plan the trip?

Planning is free. You tell OND vAI where you want to go, when, with whom, and how much you want to spend, and you receive a day-by-day itinerary with suggestions for flights, hotels, and tours.

Can I travel to a destination that is not on this list?

Yes, you can. These are the most sought-after destinations, but OND VAI organizes trips to anywhere in Brazil and the world.

Which domestic destination should I choose for my first trip?

Rio de Janeiro, Salvador, Porto de Galinhas, Maceió, and Natal have good infrastructure, direct flights from several capital cities, and options for all budgets. For nature, Foz do Iguaçu and Bonito are excellent choices.

Which international destination is easiest for Brazilians?

Buenos Aires, Santiago, and Bariloche are just a few hours' flight away and accept a valid national identity card (RG) in good condition, without a passport. Lisbon is the easiest gateway to Europe, with no language barrier.

How do I talk to a person at OND?

Contact us via WhatsApp at (11) 91021-4133 or by email at renan@ondviajar.com.br. Our team will accompany you throughout your trip, from planning to your return.
